cd /workspace && source .venv/bin/activate && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen POMODORO_DATA_DIR=/tmp/pomo_abort python - <<'PY' 2>&1
from pathlib import Path
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
from pomodoro.gui.main_window import MainWindow
from pomodoro.core.timer import TimerConfig
qa=QApplication([])
w=MainWindow(Path('/workspace/sounds')); w.show()
tv=w.timer_view
tv.tag_input.setText("admin")
cfg=TimerConfig(focus_minutes=1.0, break_minutes=1.0, rounds=3, long_break_enabled=False, long_break_interval=3)
tv.engine.apply_config(cfg); tv.engine.start()
print("state",tv.engine.state,"phase",tv.engine.phase,"remaining",tv.engine.remaining_seconds)
tv.engine.tick(30)  # halfway into 60s focus
print("remaining after 30s tick:", tv.engine.remaining_seconds)
tv._on_stop_clicked()
import sqlite3
rows=list(sqlite3.connect('/tmp/pomo_abort/pomodoro.db').execute("select duration_minutes, tag, completed from focus_sessions"))
print("DB rows after abort:", rows)
# now complete a full focus round
tv.engine.start(); tv.engine.tick(60)
rows=list(sqlite3.connect('/tmp/pomo_abort/pomodoro.db').execute("select duration_minutes, tag, completed from focus_sessions"))
print("DB rows after full round:", rows)
QTimer.singleShot(200, qa.quit); qa.exec()
PY
echo "EXIT=$?"
